Rachna Shah urges BRICS nations to enhance action against fugitives and illicit assets

Rachna Shah, addressing BRICS finance ministers and central bank governors, called for strengthened cooperation to combat financial crimes. She emphasized that no single country can effectively tackle corruption and illicit financial flows alone. Shah urged for more robust collective action against fugitives and the recovery of stolen assets. The meeting focused on enhancing collaboration among BRICS nations to address these transnational financial challenges.
